name: Saratte Mita W
source:
A superficially elite guy named Nanafushi had a secret. 

His secret was that he is a lolicon. 

Stress made him obsess. His urges could not be satisfied. 
Finally he snatched a young girl to keep in his bedroom. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107750.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
表面上是精英的七五三木有一个秘密。

他的秘密是，他是个萝莉控。

压力让他越发着迷，欲望始终得不到满足。
最终，他绑架了一名年幼女孩，把她关在卧室里。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107750.html]DLsite English[/url]）
